title: Croatian Pastry Puffs
description: Delicious flaky pastry filled with a savory Croatian-inspired pilaf. Perfect as a snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Croatian Pastry
ingredients.notes: Available at most European bakeries or make your own

instructions: Roll out the Croatian pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut into squares, about 3 inches per side.
Place a spoonful of pilaf in the center of each square.
Fold the pastry into a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle with salt and paprika.
Place the puffs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
